content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**What changed from the prior submission:** the redline no longer deletes "SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11". That scope limit is Customer-favourable (TrueLink is otherwise uncapped for warranty and service-performance breaches) and is not required by any fallback element, so it is retained verbatim.

**Final proposal (two surgical replaces in p0077):**
1. "IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY" → "IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY" — makes the cap mutual so Client's presently unlimited exposure (including under Section 12(a)) is capped.
2. "(OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE" → "(OTHER THAN A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, GROSS NEGLIGENCE" — makes the existing gross negligence/wilful misconduct exception mutual and adds indemnification and confidentiality carve-outs.

The 12-month hosting-and-support compensation basis and all surrounding indemnity mechanics survive untouched; preferred-level items (USD 1m floor, "paid or payable", event-anchored window, consequential-damages exclusion, data protection/security, fraud and IP carve-outs, payment-obligations exclusion) are flagged in the rationale for use if the clause is reopened.
